I don't normally leave reviews online, but I feel compelled to do so now. We went to the Ocean Clinic on Koh Tao with our daughter. They made a serious misdiagnosis. The doctor told us that our 11-year-old daughter had contracted a serious bacterial infection and that we needed to go to the hospital on Koh Samui for more extensive tests. We went there, and it turned out to be a harmless childhood illness. At the Ocean Clinic, we had to undergo unnecessary X-rays, were prescribed the wrong medication, had to rebook our vacation (and incurred significant additional costs), and were, above all, terrified. I would never go to this clinic again; I would go straight to a regular hospital.

text:
I was there today because I wanted a vitamin C infusion, as I’ve had it several times before when I was sick, and it helped me a lot. He said, sure, vitamin C, we can do that.

But when I later googled what they had administered, it turned out to be saline solution and an antibiotic (I absolutely did not want to take an antibiotic). When I asked why the vitamin C was missing, he said I didn’t need it and claimed that the saline solution was actually vitamin B, which he said was better for me.

And all this for a price of $330 USD. I’m from Switzerland, one of the most expensive countries in the world, and even there, this wouldn’t cost that much. Now I’m out $330 USD, I’ve been given an antibiotic that I absolutely didn’t want, and I still haven’t had my vitamin C infusion.
